title: A comparison of computational methods for expression forecasting.
authors: Kernfeld, Eric; Yang, Yunxiao; Weinstock, Joshua S; Battle, Alexis; Cahan, Patrick
one_liner_zh: 该文比较基因表达预测的计算方法，聚焦扰动后表达变化，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diverse machine learning methods promise to forecast gene expression changes in response to novel genetic perturbations. However, these methods' accuracy is not well characterized. We created a benchmarking platform that combines a panel of 11 large-scale perturbation datasets with an expression forecasting software engine that encompasses or interfaces to a wide variety of methods. We used our platform to assess methods, parameters, and sources of auxiliary data, finding that it is uncommon for expression forecasting methods to outperform simple baselines. Our platform will serve as a resource to improve methods and to identify contexts in which expression forecasting can succeed.
abstract_zh: 多种机器学习方法有望预测基因表达对新型遗传扰动的响应变化。然而，这些方法的准确性尚未得到充分表征。我们构建了一个基准测试平台，该平台结合了11个大规模扰动数据集的面板与一个涵盖或对接多种方法的表达预测软件引擎。我们利用该平台评估了方法、参数及辅助数据来源，发现表达预测方法超越简单基线的情况并不常见。我们的平台将作为改进方法并识别表达预测可成功应用场景的资源。
